cues.text: Welcome to Module 8. We're going to master the complete inspection protocol to ensure you crush it in the field.
It all starts with trust.
We have a fiduciary responsibility to act in our customers' best interest.
Legally and ethically. No excuses.
Let's review anatomy. You'll see asphalt shingles, metal, and cedar.
And know your shapes. The triangular gable versus the four-sided hip roof.
When decoding storm damage, know your targets.
Hail is a bruiser. It leaves circular dents. Wind is a lifter. It creases or rips shingles off.
To keep reports clear, use our system. Circle hail damage slash for wind.
Precision here builds your credibility. Look for granule loss in gutters. That's the roof's sunscreen washing away.
And check soft metals like vents and downspouts for dents.
Follow the inspection playbook.
One. Snap the mailbox.
Two. Get a wide shot of the house.
Three. Do a full lap to check all four sides for collateral damage.
Safety is non-negotiable.
Place your ladder on solid ground and always wear your cougar paws to grip the roof and save your hide.
Build your case like a lawyer. Collateral damage like torn screens or dented AC units is your evidence to win the homeowners claim.
Finally, your mission. The magic number is 70. Knock 70 doors a day. It's all about activity and consistency.
So get out there, start knocking and let's build something great.
